cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from engine import project
def ref_contrib(m, b, c, u, v):
    cl = lambda x: max(0, min(x, c-b))
    return (m*cl(v-b))//(c-b) - (m*cl(u-b))//(c-b)
rng = random.Random(4242)
for trial in range(4000):
    U = rng.randint(4, 50)
    kold = rng.randint(0, min(3, U-1)); knew = rng.randint(0, min(4, U-1))
    old = [0] + sorted(rng.sample(range(1, U), kold)) + [U]
    new = [0] + sorted(rng.sample(range(1, U), knew)) + [U]
    vals = [rng.randint(0, 500) for _ in range(len(old)-1)]
    out = project(old, vals, new, len(new)-1)
    exp = [0]*(len(new)-1)
    for j, m in enumerate(vals):
        b, c = old[j], old[j+1]
        for k in range(len(new)-1):
            exp[k] += ref_contrib(m, b, c, new[k], new[k+1])
    assert out == exp, (old, vals, new, out, exp)
    assert sum(out) == sum(vals)
print('multi-range projection matches brute force on 4000 random cases')
EOF
